review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this intentionally pending planning case. It preserves REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, and DEC-001; requires repository, requirements, and decisions evidence; and correctly expects B to stop at decisions with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001. The recommendation and conditional acceptance language do not authorize choosing OPT-1 or OPT-2. Empty task and assignment expectations therefore match the specification; TASK-IMPLEMENT and TASK-VERIFY apply only after resolution. The supplied source supports src/index.ts as the implementation binding owner, with the two test files serving regression and type-verification roles. Package configuration, ignored outputs, CI sequencing, and the fixed upstream microbundle evidence support treating index.d.ts as generated rather than a separately maintained owner. Read-only consumers do not require mandatory edits. The empty team capability facts do not justify assignments, but do not introduce an earlier blocker: the supplied policy places the material decision gate before Scenario Coverage and its reviewer prerequisite. Gold and preview release-input fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decision input, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. The original specification's preparation-state null releaseInput and remaining-work list are distinguishable from the supplied frozen preview. Any fixed hypothetical C input is not human confirmation or resolution of DEC-001. This is a review of the supplied specification and frozen evidence only, without candidates, human attestation, code execution, or independent digest recomputation; digest binding is accepted as Service-provided.
